About Purple Dragon

Independent software and creative work by Kyle Austin Hillier.

Built around practical problems

I’m Kyle Austin Hillier, the creator behind Purple Dragon Foundation. I build Windows utilities, browser enhancements, local AI workflows, and experimental creative tools.

The projects grow through hands-on development, testing, feedback, and refinement. Clear controls, useful features, and a recognizable visual identity guide the work.

Alongside software, I create music. Listen through the official artist links.
